about.title: Poway Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Poway recorded 5 traffic deaths alongside 70 injury collisions in the most recent full year of data, numbers that translate into real families navigating unimaginable loss. When a crash on Twin Peaks Road, Pomerado Road, or one of Poway's other busy corridors takes a life, California law gives certain surviving family members a path to hold the responsible party accountable through a civil wrongful death claim. This is separate from any criminal proceeding and follows its own rules, including strict time limits and specific categories of people who may bring the claim. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we're a free service that connects grieving families with an independent attorney who can explain standing, deadlines, and what losses may be recoverable. You focus on your family. We help you find someone who can focus on the legal process. There's no fee unless the attorney secures a recovery on your behalf.

whyChoose.title: What Families in Poway Should Know

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain circumstances. An independent attorney can help sort out who qualifies in your family's specific situation.

items.title: The Clock Starts Running Quickly
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Given Poway's mix of state routes and city-maintained roads, figuring out which deadline applies matters early on.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial costs and lost financial support, but also for the loss of love, companionship, and guidance a family member provided. An attorney can help document these losses accurately.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may be able to bring the claim. An independent attorney can review your family's circumstances to confirm eligibility.

items.question: How much time do we have to file after a fatal crash in Poway?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as one responsible for maintaining Route 67 or Poway Road, may be involved, the deadline is much shorter and requires early action.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, they're separate. A criminal case is brought by the state and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family seeking compensation for their losses. One can proceed regardless of the outcome of the other.
